notes.title: Project Vesperi Demo Patch 1 Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the Project Vesperi Demo! Our small team has been hard at work improving your experience and building the full game. Please continue to let us know if you run into any additional issues. Below are the bug fixes and changes for Demo Patch 1:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sensitivity settings were not saving. Sensitivity settings should now apply properly for both mouse and keyboard and controller.
[*] Fixed an issue where adjusting graphics settings broke lighting. Making adjustments to graphics settings now reloads the level.
[*] Fixed a bug where a character could disappear during cinematics.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted memory shards in the Void to trigger sooner.
[*] Texture pass on characters for added detail in the faces and subsurface scattering for those running on higher settings.
[*] Adjusted UI to be constrained to 16x9 for wider aspect ratios.
[*] Various performance improvements.
[*] Animation improvements.
[/list]
[b]Upcoming Fixes and Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability to turn off all camera shake is in progress and should be included in the next patch.
[/list]

notes.title: Meet Our Student-Led Team!
notes.content:
Hello there, welcome to our first Steam Page Announcement!

Our team is thrilled to be launching the Project Vesperi Demo for Steam Next Fest, where you can play the first chapter of our game’s story. Come meet our student-led team in a video series on our YouTube channel called Venus Unveiled, featuring the creatives, developers, actors, and more who all came together to build Project Vesperi.

[previewyoutube=oVk3_E01v-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, come say hi to us on [url=https://discord.gg/u4vEYuErnC]Discord[/url], or on our other [url=https://linktr.ee/vesperigame]socials[/url], where we’ll be posting updates on the game as it gets closer to launch in 2025. We’re very excited to be able to finally put our first game out there and we look forward to having you join us on our journey to release so you can discover the mysteries behind the sign of life as Doctor Evelyn Roth.

Thank you so much for checking out the demo, and if you run into any bugs or issues, please don’t hesitate to contact us on our Discord or email us at: contact@lastpraetorianinteractive.com
